description.zh: 对Object名字进行分组的字符。所有名字包含指定的前缀且第一次出现Delimiter字符之间的Object作为一组元素CommonPrefixes。
description.en: A character used to group file names. All file names that share the same string between the prefix and the first occurrence of the delimiter are grouped into a single CommonPrefixes element.
The name of the temporary file.
The number of entries per page.
Filters the results to include only files whose names start with the specified prefix.
The field to use for sorting.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw list-temp-files --name filename --prefix somedir/ --delimiter / --instance-id dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtModifiedTime --order DESC --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dsw GET /api/v2/tempfiles --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --Delimiter '/' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId 'dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --SortBy GmtModifiedTime --Prefix 'somedir/' --Name filename --header "Content-Type=application/json"
